nodes.description: Off-label idebenone has limited human evidence in OPA1-related optic atrophy. A 2020 retrospective comparison of 50 treated and 37 untreated patients found stabilization/recovery of the better-seeing eye in 92% versus 75.7%, with adjusted odds ratio 4.37 (95% CI 1.01–18.9). A 2023 uncontrolled prospective phase 2 study treated 16 patients for 12 months and reported a small improvement in its best-recovery endpoint. Neither design establishes efficacy: selection bias, prolonged natural stability, measurement variation and placebo effects remain relevant. Animal studies measured different endpoints and did not show consistent rescue.

In the 2022 iPSC study, a CRISPR heterozygous null line and a classic delTTAG patient line had reduced OPA1 transcripts; inhibition of nonsense-mediated decay increased expression. The knockout lines had approximately half-normal protein. These measurements support haploinsufficiency without assuming that every variant or cell type produces an identical 50% protein reduction. Missense variants can also cause isolated disease; their functional effects and association with DOA-plus require variant-specific interpretation.

nodes.description: Bioenergetic impairment is measured in several OPA1 disease models but is not uniform across assays and cell types. The 2022 iPSC-RGC study found reduced basal respiration and ATP-linked output in engineered-null, classic delTTAG and DOA-plus R445H lines. Maximal respiration was reduced in knockout and DOA-plus cultures but not significantly in the classic patient line. Cultured Q285STOP mouse RGCs also had impaired respiratory parameters. In contrast, isolated lymphoblast mitochondria from six OPA1-positive patients showed no significant respiratory or electron-transport defect. Fusion, cristae and genome-maintenance abnormalities are candidate contributors; cytochrome c release forms a parallel apoptotic pathway.

nodes.description: Four primary skin fibroblast lines carrying different heterozygous OPA1 mutations — nonsense and missense, in the GTPase and the C-terminal coiled-coil domains — analysed in parallel and quantitatively, which was the point of the study: earlier fibroblast reports had been mutually inconsistent. The panel shows defective fusion on pharmacological challenge, abnormal fragmentation under glycolysis shortage or oxidative stress, reduced complex IV activity, and distorted cristae, with a physical OPA1-oxidative-phosphorylation interaction on reciprocal immunoprecipitation. It is the human in vitro counterweight to the study of isolated patient mitochondria that found electron transport unaltered.

evidence.snippet: Skin fibroblasts with heterozygous OPA1 mutations thus share significant mitochondrial remodeling, and may therefore be useful for analyzing disease pathophysiology.

nodes.description: RGCs purified from postnatal day 6–7 mice were examined in culture. Mitochondrial imaging at day 8 showed shorter, more mobile mitochondria, while day-3 Seahorse assays showed reduced basal, ATP-linked and maximal respiration. Enhanced motility was proposed as compensation, not demonstrated restoration of fusion.

nodes.description: The end state of the mechanism: progressive, selective loss of retinal ganglion cells and their axons, with consequent optic nerve degeneration. DOA was described from the outset as a non-syndromic loss of visual acuity of insidious onset in early childhood caused by progressive and selective retinal ganglion cell loss, and that selectivity — rather than any systemic mitochondrial failure — is what defines the classic form.

nodes.description: STK-002 is an investigational antisense oligonucleotide that suppresses inclusion of a naturally occurring nonproductive OPA1 exon, increasing productive expression. In three haploinsufficient patient fibroblast lines it increased OPA1 and respiratory reserve. Single intravitreal doses increased total retinal OPA1 in healthy cynomolgus monkeys; a rabbit-specific surrogate ST-1102 was used in rabbits. These are target-engagement and cellular rescue data, not evidence of restored human vision. The target exon is not conserved in rodents.

nodes.description: Degeneration is not uniform across the retinal ganglion cell population. The smallest-calibre fibres, which make up the papillomacular bundle serving central vision, are affected first and most severely. That topography explains the clinical triad directly: temporal pallor of the optic disc, a central or centrocecal field defect, and early loss of central acuity and colour discrimination. The same pattern recurs across a large number of optic neuropathies of mitochondrial origin, including Leber hereditary optic neuropathy and the toxic and nutritional optic neuropathies, which is why it is modelled here as a property of the fibre population rather than as something specific to OPA1.

nodes.description: Larvae under 131 hours postfertilization showed impaired optokinetic responses, preserved gross locomotor responses and abnormal RGC-axon mitochondria. Homozygous germline mutants survived the tested larval stage but were absent at two months. Whole-larva respiration was assayed in crispants; basal and ATP-linked output were unchanged, while maximal respiration decreased. The knockout/mosaic perturbations differ from human heterozygous disease.
